description: Scala source code for Spark plugin that manages periodic rolling and decommissioning of executor pods in Kubernetes environment.

classes.name: ExecutorRollPlugin
classes.description: Spark plugin to roll executor pods periodically, supporting decommissioning in static and dynamic allocation.

classes.name: ExecutorRollDriverPlugin
classes.description: Driver plugin implementing the logic for executor rolling based on policies and metrics.

methods.name: driverPlugin
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ExecutorRollDriverPlugin.

methods.name: executorPlugin
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no executor plugin implementation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up periodic executor for rolling, and configures policies based on SparkContext configuration.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the periodic executor service.

methods.name: getPeakMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves peak memory metrics from executor summary.

methods.name: choose
methods.description: Selects an executor ID to roll based on the specified policy and executor metrics.

methods.name: outliersFromMultipleDimensions
methods.description: Generates a list of outlier executors based on multiple metrics.

methods.name: outliers
methods.description: Identifies outliers in executor metrics using a 2-sigma threshold.
